def comps(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    lab=[[-1]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for a in range(H):

            if g[a][b]!=0 and lab[a][b]==-1:
                col=g[a][b]; q=[(a,b)]; lab[a][b]=id(col); cells=[]
                while q:
                    x,y=q.pop(); cells.append((x,y))
                    for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nx,ny=x+dx,y+dy
                        if 0<=nx<H and 0<=ny<W and g[nx][ny]!=0 and lab[nx][ny]==-1:
                            lab[nx][ny]=id(col); q.append((nx,ny))
                out.append(cells)
    return out
